ind. [अह्-ए] A particle implying 
___(a) Reproach, 
___(b) Regret. 
___(c) Separation.
a. Causeless, spontaneous, involuntary; अहेतुः पक्षपातो यः [[

.]] 
-तुः Absence of cause and reason. 
-Comp. 
-समः A particular sophism tending to prove an argument to be untenable, Nyāyadarśana.

अहे(है)तुक
a. 
__1 Groundless, causeless, without any motive; कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम् [[

.]] 
-कम् ind. Without extraneous aid, through one's own ability or power.

अहेळ(ड)त्, -हेडमान
a. Ved. Not unwilling; अहेळमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशंस मा न आयुः प्रमोषीः [[
N. of the plant शतमूली or महाशतावरी. Asparagus Racemosus.
